Deadline: Non-Malaysians: apply at least 6 months before the training start date; accept offer within 1 month of offer letter
Eligibility: Basic medical degree recognised by MMC; paediatric postgraduate qualification recognised by the Malaysian Specialty Board (MMed Paeds, MRCP, MRCPCH, MRCPI, FRACP); training after gazettement as paediatrician; General UMMC requirements: Master's degree/clinical master or equivalent recognised by the Malaysian Medical Council (MMC); registration with MMC; Professional Visit Pass (PLIK) approval; support of Head of Clinical Department; approval by UMMC Credentialing and Privileging Committee
International applicants: Yes - UMMC states its Clinical Fellowship Programme is offered to both local and overseas candidates; non-Malaysian fees apply
Application method: Apply online via the UMMC Fellowship/Training Attachment Programme e-services portal (register and log in)
Funding: Self-funded training fee: non-Malaysian RM36,000 per year (Malaysian RM18,000) plus RM100 management fee, prorated monthly; 15% discount for Lower Middle Income and 30% for Low Income Countries (World Bank)
Visa support: Professional Visit Pass (PLIK) approved by the Immigration Department of Malaysia is a stated requirement
Licence requirement: Registration with the Malaysian Medical Council
Summary: Accredited paediatric respiratory training covering ward, referrals, polysomnography, lung function and flexible bronchoscopy, in line with the National Specialist Curriculum.
